title: Meeting Someone New
summaryZh: 兩位同事在辦公室第一次見面，互相自我介紹，並約好一起喝咖啡。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi there, I'm Ben. Are you new here?
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是 Ben。你是新來的嗎？
sentences.note: Are you → /ɑɹjə/，are 弱讀成 /ɚ/，兩字連成一個音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, I am. My name is Mia, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 對，我是新來的。我叫 Mia，很高興認識你。
sentences.note: nice to meet you 的 to 弱讀成 /tə/；meet you 連音成 /miːtʃu/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Nice to meet you too. Where do you sit?
sentences.zh: 我也很高興認識你。你坐在哪裡？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I sit by the window, right next to the door.
sentences.zh: 我坐在窗邊，就在門旁邊。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's a good spot. It gets a lot of light.
sentences.zh: 那個位置很好，採光很不錯。
sentences.note: a lot of → /əlɑɾəv/，lot 的 t 變閃音，of 弱讀成 /əv/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It does. So what do you do here, Ben?
sentences.zh: 真的很亮。那你在這裡做什麼工作，Ben？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I work on the design team. We make websites.
sentences.zh: 我在設計團隊，我們負責做網站。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That sounds fun. I'm on the sales team.
sentences.zh: 聽起來很有趣。我是業務團隊的。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Cool. Do you want to get coffee sometime?
sentences.zh: 很棒。你哪天要不要一起去喝杯咖啡？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sure, I'd love that. How about tomorrow morning?
sentences.zh: 好啊，我很願意。明天早上如何？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Tomorrow works for me. Let's meet at nine.
sentences.zh: 明天我可以。我們九點碰面吧。
sentences.note: for me 的 for 弱讀成 /fɚ/；meet at 連讀且 t 變閃音 /miːɾæt/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Great, I'll see you then. Have a good day!
sentences.zh: 太好了，那到時候見。祝你有美好的一天！

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You too, Mia. And welcome to the team!
sentences.zh: 你也是，Mia。歡迎加入我們團隊！

questions.q: What team does Ben work on?
What do they plan to do tomorrow?
